verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਆਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਭੈ ਭਾਰ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhai vich dharat aagaas hai niraadhaar bhai bhaar dharaiaa|

en.bdb: Earth and sky are in fear but not held by any support, and, that Lord sustains them under the weight of fears.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paun paanee baisa(n)taro bhai vich rakhai mel milaiaa|

en.bdb: Keeping air, water and fire in fear (discipline). He has mixed them all (and has created the world).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਧਰਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਥੰਮ੍ਹਾ ਆਗਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paanee a(n)dhar dharat dhar vin tha(n)mhaa aagaas rahaiaa|

en.bdb: Setting earth in water He has established sky without the support of any props.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਠੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਧਰਿ ਕਰ ਪਰਫੁਲਤੁ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaaThai a(n)dhar agan dhar kar parafulat sufal falaiaa|

en.bdb: He kept fire in wood and loading the trees with flowers and fruits made them meaningful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਵੀ ਦੁਆਰੀ ਪਵਣੁ ਧਰਿ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: navee dhuaaree pavan dhar bhai vich sooraj cha(n)dh chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Keeping air (life) in all the nine doors He made the sun and the moon to move in fear (discipline).
That spotless Lord Himself is beyond all fears.
